tubuild create reported one declaration CONFLICT: the legacy Behavior source declared _ZN10dBgActor_c19UpdateClsnPosAndRotEv returning int and the legacy InitResources source returning void. The class-body destructor makes this the key-function TU, so the compile emits the class vtable and the inherited vague-linkage RTTI chain. Every emitted record resolves to a cartridge address and is licensed below as deadstrip-data against that address; no config/arm9/overlays/*/symbols.txt row was added, moved or renamed to make one resolve. This is the promotion that PR #2756's rename to the ROM RTTI name unblocked: under the earlier coined spelling _ZTI6ShipUp and _ZTS6ShipUp had no ROM home at all, and tubuild refused to license them.
